title: "Tests for Quarto stuff"
categories: [observable, test]
---

Here we have a form made up from some sliders that have be generated programmatically. We want to display the total of the sliders reacting to changes in slider values.
```{ojs}

monthly_means = {
    const data = [3.2,2.9,3.7,3.5,3.8,3.9,4.3,4.4,3.8,3.3,3,3.4,]
    return data;
}

function makeInputs() {
    const data = [];
    for (let i=0; i<12; i++) {
        data.push(Inputs.range([0,12], {step:0.1, value:monthly_means[i], label: `Month ${i}`}));
    }
    return data;
}

function getTotal(monthly) {
    let mtotal = 0;
    for (const item of monthly){
        mtotal = mtotal+item;
    }
    return mtotal;
}

input_list = makeInputs();

viewof months = Inputs.form(input_list);

total = {
    yield getTotal(months, 5, 1, 10);
}

```

The total is: ${total}
